Both Assistant A and Assistant B provided relevant and insightful answers to the user's question about how the stages of life shape our understanding of time and mortality. However, when it comes to the allegorical poem, Assistant B's poem better illustrates the stages of life and the changing sense of time and mortality. Assistant B's poem uses the metaphor of a river to represent the passage of time and the different stages of life, which effectively conveys the user's request. Therefore, I choose Assistant B as the better assistant in this case.
